title: Every five years, a commission splits the tax pool
sources: Report of the Fifteenth Finance Commission (2021–26)

quiz.q: The Finance Commission is constituted under:

review.note: Written and voiced by Claude (AI voices, Kokoro), 8 Nov 2026. Not yet checked by a subject or Hindi editor. Kept to the Fifteenth Commission; update when the Sixteenth Commission's devolution share is confirmed.

lines.say: The Centre collects most taxes. The states do most of the spending.
So who decides how the money is shared?

beats.say: The Centre collects most taxes. The states do most of the spending. So who decides how the money is shared?

lines.say: Under Article 280, the President sets up a Finance Commission every five years.
It recommends how central taxes are shared with the states.

data.text: The President sets up a Finance Commission every five years, or earlier.

beats.say: Under Article 280, the President sets up a Finance Commission every five years. It recommends how central taxes are shared with the states.

lines.say: The Fifteenth Commission, chaired by N. K. Singh,
gave the states 41 percent of the divisible pool.

items.label: of the divisible pool to states, 2021–26

beats.say: The Fifteenth Commission, chaired by N. K. Singh, gave the states 41 percent of the divisible pool.

lines.say: Poorer states get more, through income distance.
Population, area, forest cover, and demographic performance also count.
